senses.gloss: (b. h.; Saf. of עוד, cmp. סְהֵד)to support, strengthen.
units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2">Lam. R. to II, 2</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:13">Y. Taan. IV, 68ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>לא תִסְעוֹד</he>, v. <he>סָבַף</he>.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 41:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. XLI, 3</cite> <he>אני סוֹעֲדוֹ ומעמידו</he> I will strengthen and raise him (from his sick-bed); a. fr.

senses.gloss: (with or without לב) to satisfy the appetite, to satiate.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 78:7">Midr. Till. to Ps. CIV, 15</cite> <he>הלחם סוֹעד</he> (ed. Bub. <he>לבב</he>) bread satiates, v. <cite ref="M00736"><he>מְזוֹנִיתָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 675:4">Yalk. Lev. 675</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 26:26">Lev. XXVI, 26</cite>) <he>לרבות כל סוֹעֲדֵי לחם</he> (fr. a noun <cite ref="O00380"><he>סוֹעָד</he></cite>) this include all supports by bread (all substitutes of food); Sifra B’ḥuck. Par. 2, ch. VI <he>מְסָעֲדֵי</he> or <he>מִסְעֲדֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Chullin 7b:4">Ḥull. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>רצונך סְעוֹד אצלי</he> please dine with me.
<cite ref="Eruvin 53b:19">Erub. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>מדוע אינך סוֹעֵד</he> why dost thou not eat?; <he>כבר סָעַדְתִּי וכ׳</he> I have had my meal in daytime; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 62b:23">Sabb. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>במה סָעַדְתָּ היום</he> what did you dine on to-day? (a lascivious metaphor).—[<cite ref="Shabbat 12b:3">Ib. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>ששכינה סועד</he>, v. <cite ref="O01293"><he>סָעַר</he> I</cite>.]
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 760:2">Yalk. Num. 760</cite> <he>לסַעֲדָהּ</he> in order to keep her (the cow) steady (on the ship).
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 18:3">Sabb. XVIII, 3</cite> <he>אבל מְסַעֲדִין</he> but you may assist (an animal in child-birth); expl.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 15:2">Tosef. ib. XV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:2">XVI</cite>), 2) <he>כיצד מסעדין אוחזין וכ׳</he> (Tosef. l. c. <he>מסייעין</he>).
